evals.name: no invented specifics
evals.prompt: Lightly edit: The integration improved efficiency. The launch marks a pivotal moment for the company.
checks: No invented time savings, mechanisms, product history, or source.

evals.name: technical voice
evals.prompt: Edit lightly: We used robust regression. I think the estimate is shaky, honestly. The report shows a wide interval.
checks: Keep robust regression and natural inanimate subject.
Preserve meaningful uncertainty; no forced rewriting.

evals.name: flag only
evals.prompt: Flag without rewriting: Here is the thing: our transformative platform empowers every team.
checks: No rewritten draft, score, or authorship claim.

evals.name: clean draft
evals.prompt: Flag without rewriting: I sent the invoice on Tuesday. Please confirm it arrived.
